name: Oath of Glory Spells
description:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Glory Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Guiding Bolt, Heroism

Level 5: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon

Level 9: Haste, Protection from Energy

Level 13: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement

Level 17: Legend Lore, Yolande’s Regal Presence
